title: About You
text:
THE PERSON BEHIND THE DATA
      Hi, I'm Richard.I connect the dots.
      Between data and decisions.Between a good question and a useful answer.
      I'm a Boston University student exploring business analytics, big data, and cloud computing. I like making complex information easier to understand—and easier to act on.
      Explore my interests ↗
      Boston UniversityBusiness analyticsAlways learning
    
    
      CONNECTING THE DOTS↗

      Curiosity → evidence → clarityRW.
    
  
  MY FOCUSBusiness questions ✳ Data exploration ✳ Clear communication
  
    01 / A LITTLE CONTEXTCurious by nature.Practical by choice.
    What is driving a change in performance? Which patterns deserve a closer look? How can an analysis help someone decide what to do next?Those are the questions that draw me to analytics. Through my coursework, I'm building a foundation in working with data at different scales, exploring evidence, and explaining what it means in a business context.I care about the entire process: starting with the right question, checking the data, and communicating findings with their limitations.
  
  
    02 / MY TOOLKIT IN PROGRESSLearning with purpose.Four areas I'm exploring.One goal: make the analysis useful.
    
      { }01Code & exploreUsing Python to organize data, investigate patterns, and turn questions into reproducible analysis.PythonData analysis
      ▤02Query & scaleLearning how SQL and Apache Spark make structured data accessible, from a single table to larger datasets.SQLApache Spark
      ☁03Build in the cloudUnderstanding how cloud tools support scalable workflows and connect the pieces of an analytics process.Cloud computingWorkflows
      ↗04Explain the signalBringing statistics and visualization together to communicate evidence clearly and put results in context.StatisticsVisualization
    
  
  03 / HOW I THINKA question-first approach.01AskDefine the business question and what a useful answer would look like.02ExploreCheck the data, look for patterns, and challenge the first explanation.03ExplainMake the findings understandable, including what the data cannot tell us.04ApplyConnect the evidence to a practical recommendation or a better next question.
  04 / THE NEXT CHAPTERBetter decisions.Real business impact.My goal is to become a data analyst or business analyst, combining technical skills with an understanding of business needs. I'm interested in improving operations, understanding customer behavior, and measuring performance.↗Keep building.Keep asking why.This portfolio is a record of my learning—one project, one question, and one insight at a time.
